race.description: Picklebet’s Get Your Pickle On Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: Looks a nice race for MY BONNIE LASSIE (3) who wound up strongly last time out to finish half a length adrift in third over 1017m at Moe in a BM62 having won her maiden at Wangaratta prior. Still improving against a few of these and will be very hard to hold out. SHELLY'S LEGACY (2) found the line nicely last start to get up for third over 1170m at Wangaratta, continuing his solid form this time in. Could possible land a pair closer now and takes some beating. APPLE CIDER (7) faded late after showing speed at Albury last time out, finishing third. Back in trip for this looks okay. FIRST DIVISION (4) tackled city class last start when eighth over 1050m at Morphettville. This suits better and the win here prior was dominant albeit in slightly easier.
